html:
The Pisones were a native people of southwest Tamaulipas, in northeast Mexico, on the edge of the Sierra Madre Oriental. They are known mainly from Spanish records of the 1700s.

They were hunter-gatherers, one of the many Tamaulipeco bands of the region, with the Janambres as neighbours. When José de Escandón founded the colony of Nuevo Santander from 1748, some Pisones were settled in missions. Disease and war ended them as a separate people.
